zh: 老话说，三十年河东，三十年河西。
en: As the old saying goes, fortune shifts from one side to the other.

zh: AI这一次，可能等不了三十年。
en: This time, AI may not wait thirty years.

zh: 同样一套AI工具，
en: With the very same AI tools,

zh: 有人用了之后自身价值被稀释，
en: some people see their value diluted,

zh: 有人却借它把能力无限放大。
en: while others use them to amplify their abilities.

zh: 从来不是会不会用工具的差距。
en: The difference is not whether you can use the tools.

zh: 核心区别只有一点：
en: There is only one core distinction:

zh: 是AI在支配你，还是你掌控AI。
en: does AI control you, or do you control AI?

zh: AI负责产出答案，
en: AI produces answers,

zh: 谁负责判断、取舍、最终定夺，为结果负责？
en: but who judges, chooses, decides, and owns the result?

zh: 咱们把最近这一周的工作都回想一下。
en: Think back over all the work we did this past week.

zh: 写方案、回客户、整理资料、做报价，
en: Drafting plans, replying to clients, organizing files, quoting prices,

zh: 还有选标题、剪视频、员工安排等等。
en: choosing titles, editing videos, arranging staff, and more.

zh: AI做出一版方案后，你补了什么？
en: After AI produced a draft, what did you add?

zh: 又做了哪些决定？最终采用了哪些？
en: What decisions did you make, and what did you finally use?

zh: 这个问题咱们先放在脑子里，后面都会有答案。
en: Keep that question in mind. The answer will become clear.

zh: 斯坦福经济学家布林约尔松，
en: Stanford economist Erik Brynjolfsson

zh: 在一个访谈里讲过一个判断：
en: once made this observation in an interview:

zh: 未来十年，AI可能带来最好的十年，
en: AI could bring the best decade ahead,

zh: 也可能带来最坏的十年。
en: or it could bring the worst.

zh: 这句话是不是听起来很矛盾？
en: Does that sound contradictory?

zh: 技术创造了更多的价值，是一回事。
en: Technology creating more value is one matter.

zh: 消费者得到更多便利，是一回事。
en: Consumers gaining more convenience is another.

zh: 普通劳动者能不能分到更高的收入，
en: Whether ordinary workers receive higher incomes

zh: 有没有议价能力，又是另外一回事。
en: and retain bargaining power is yet another.

zh: 所以咱们普通人不能只问一句：
en: So ordinary people cannot ask only one question:

zh: AI会不会替代我？
en: Will AI replace me?

zh: 更现实的问法是：
en: A more realistic question is:

zh: 我正在做的这些任务，AI进来以后，
en: when AI enters the tasks I perform,

zh: 是在增强我，还是把我拆成更便宜的一段执行？
en: does it augment me, or reduce me to cheaper execution?

zh: 我先说个场景。就说客服，
en: Consider customer support as an example.

zh: 很多标准问题：订单在哪里、怎么退款、规则怎么解释。
en: Many questions are standard: order status, refunds, and rules.

zh: 企业如果只盯成本，
en: If a company focuses only on cost,

zh: 就会想让机器回答更多问题，
en: it will want machines to answer more questions,

zh: 人少一点，流程短一点。
en: with fewer people and shorter processes.

zh: 这是一种用法。
en: That is one way to use AI.

zh: 还有另外一种用法，
en: There is another way:

zh: 是AI站在一线员工旁边给提示。
en: AI can stand beside frontline staff and offer guidance.

zh: 这个客户可能卡在哪里，
en: Where might this customer be stuck?

zh: 之前类似的问题怎么处理，哪些话不能说，
en: How were similar cases handled, and what should not be said?

zh: 处理完以后，哪里要复盘。
en: Afterward, what should be reviewed?

zh: 尤其是公司来新人，
en: This matters especially for new employees.

zh: 原来要问老员工、翻资料、犯错再改。
en: They once had to ask veterans, search files, and learn from mistakes.

zh: 现在AI把很多经验推到他面前之后，
en: Now AI can bring much of that experience to them,

zh: 他可能会更快地接近熟手。
en: helping them approach experienced performance faster.

zh: 前一种，是任务被机器拆走。
en: In the first model, machines take tasks away.

zh: 后一种，是人的能力被放大。
en: In the second, human ability is amplified.

zh: 布林约尔松讲过“图灵陷阱”。
en: Brynjolfsson has described the Turing Trap.

zh: 对咱们普通人最有用的地方，
en: What matters most to ordinary people

zh: 不是术语本身，而是它提醒我们：
en: is not the term itself, but its warning:

zh: 当一个组织只追求让机器越来越像人，
en: when an organization only makes machines more human-like,

zh: 目标很容易变成替代人。
en: its goal can easily become replacing people.

zh: 当AI被设计成帮人看清问题、
en: When AI is designed to help people see problems clearly,

zh: 检查错误、补足知识、复盘经验，
en: check errors, fill knowledge gaps, and review experience,

zh: 人就还有成长的位置和空间。
en: people still have room to grow.

zh: 所以以后看一家公司、一份工作，
en: So when evaluating a company or a job,

zh: 不要只问它有没有用上AI。
en: do not ask only whether it uses AI.

zh: 先问一句：AI进来以后，
en: Ask first: after AI arrives,

zh: 人是学得更快了，还是只剩下更少的活了？
en: do people learn faster, or merely have less work left?

zh: 如果企业只要短期效率，
en: If a company wants only short-term efficiency

zh: 不保留训练、复核和带教，
en: and removes training, review, and mentorship,

zh: 新人表面上变快了，
en: new employees may appear faster,

zh: 可长期没有地方练自己的判断。
en: but lose the chance to develop judgment over time.

zh: 这不是说资深的老员工没用了。
en: This does not mean experienced workers are useless.

zh: 它支持的是低经验员工提升更明显。
en: The evidence shows larger gains for less experienced workers.

zh: 至于练级台阶会不会被压缩，
en: Whether the learning ladder will be compressed

zh: 这是结合就业结构延伸出来的风险判断。
en: is a risk inferred from the employment structure.

zh: 真正要看的是：
en: What really matters is this:

zh: AI最先改变的往往不是职业名称，
en: AI often changes task order before job titles,

zh: 而是职业里面的任务顺序。
en: rearranging the work inside a role.

zh: 过去一个人先做基础执行，
en: A person once began with basic execution,

zh: 再接触例外问题，最后慢慢承担判断。
en: then handled exceptions, and gradually took on judgment.

zh: 现在很多基础执行都会被机器先拿走。
en: Now machines may take many basic tasks first.

zh: 那新人拿什么来练？企业还愿不愿意带？
en: How will newcomers practice, and will firms still train them?

zh: 这会影响未来几年很多人的位置。
en: This will shape many people’s positions in the coming years.

zh: 斯坦福数字经济实验室有一项研究提到：
en: A Stanford Digital Economy Lab study reported that

zh: 在美国的数据里，
en: in US data,

zh: 二十二到二十五岁之间，
en: among people aged twenty-two to twenty-five,

zh: AI暴露度最高的一批职业里面，
en: in occupations with the highest AI exposure,

zh: 早期劳动者就业相对下降大约百分之十六。
en: early-career employment fell by about sixteen percent relatively.

zh: 它不是全球所有年轻人都少百分之十六，
en: This does not mean all young people worldwide fell sixteen percent,

zh: 也不是所有的行业都这样。
en: nor does it apply to every industry.

zh: 它限定的是美国、特定年龄段、
en: It is limited to the United States, a specific age group,

zh: AI暴露度高的职业。
en: and occupations with high AI exposure.

zh: 它提醒的是，
en: What it warns us is that

zh: 压力先会落在一种标准化、容易检查、
en: pressure may first hit standardized, easily checked

zh: 企业又愿意直接自动化的入门执行上。
en: entry-level tasks that firms are willing to automate.

zh: 所以别急着查哪个职业会消失。
en: Do not rush to search for which jobs will disappear.

zh: 职业这个词太大了。
en: A job title is too broad.

zh: 销售不是只会卖东西，设计师不是只会出图，
en: Sales is not only selling, and design is not only producing images.

zh: 会计不是只会填表，老板也不是只会拍板。
en: Accounting is not only forms, and leadership is not only decisions.

zh: 咱们要拆具体动作。
en: We need to break work into specific actions.

zh: 哪些动作是AI能够很快先做一版？
en: Which actions can AI draft quickly?

zh: 哪些动作必须知道行业背景？
en: Which require industry context?

zh: 哪些动作要听懂真实的人？
en: Which require understanding real people?

zh: 哪些动作最后要由你判断、解释和承担责任？
en: Which still require your judgment, explanation, and accountability?

zh: 你的位置不在职业名称里，
en: Your position is not inside a job title,

zh: 而是在这些任务里面。
en: but inside these tasks.

zh: 还有很多老板会有另外一个困惑：
en: Many business owners have another question:

zh: AI现在这么强，
en: AI is already so powerful,

zh: 为什么公司用了以后，好像也没有马上多赚钱？
en: so why do companies not immediately earn more after using it?

zh: 这个可以用生产率J曲线去解释。
en: The productivity J-curve helps explain this.

zh: 说简单一点，
en: Put simply,

zh: 通用技术不是装上就能见效。
en: a general-purpose technology does not pay off upon installation.

zh: 就像电力进工厂的时候，
en: When electricity entered factories,

zh: 也不是把蒸汽机换成电机就完了。
en: it was not enough to swap a steam engine for a motor.

zh: 工厂布局、生产流程、管理方式、人的技能，
en: Factory layout, production processes, management, and skills

zh: 都得跟着改。
en: all had to change.

zh: AI也是一样。
en: AI works the same way.

zh: 模型今天更新了，公司流程不会明天自动更新。
en: A model may update today, but company processes will not update tomorrow.

zh: 员工开了会员，老板买了工具，
en: Employees buy subscriptions and owners buy tools,

zh: 但客户怎么来、数据怎么流、
en: but how customers arrive and how data flows,

zh: 谁复核、谁负责，错了谁去改，
en: who reviews, who is accountable, and who fixes errors,

zh: 这些不变的话，AI很容易停在演示层。
en: if these remain unchanged, AI easily stays at the demo stage.

zh: 所以未来几年，三件事可能会同时发生：
en: Over the next few years, three things may happen together:

zh: 模型越来越强，
en: models keep getting stronger,

zh: 企业还没有完全吃到效率，
en: companies still have not captured the full efficiency,

zh: 一部分人的旧任务已经先被削弱。
en: while some people’s old tasks have already weakened.

zh: 咱们在新闻里看到的是巨大繁荣，
en: The news shows us enormous prosperity,

zh: 回到自己身上，
en: but in our own work,

zh: 感受到的是报价变低、初稿变便宜，
en: we feel lower prices and cheaper first drafts,

zh: 老板开始问：这个AI能不能先做你的工作？
en: and bosses ask whether AI can do your work first.

zh: 作为消费者，我们确实越来越方便。
en: As consumers, we are certainly gaining convenience.

zh: 搜索、翻译、写作、制图、表格，
en: Search, translation, writing, images, and spreadsheets

zh: 很多东西以前要花钱、花时间，
en: once cost time and money,

zh: 现在变便宜了，甚至免费。
en: but are now cheaper or even free.

zh: 免费数字产品给消费者创造了福利，
en: Free digital products create consumer benefits.

zh: 消费者更方便了，不等于劳动者更值钱。
en: More convenience does not mean workers become more valuable.

zh: 技术创造的总价值，是一本账。
en: The total value technology creates is one ledger.

zh: 消费者拿到的便利，是一本账。
en: The convenience consumers receive is another.

zh: 劳动者能不能分到收入、有没有议价能力，
en: Whether workers share income and retain bargaining power

zh: 是另外一本账。
en: is a third ledger.

zh: 这就是“最好”和“最坏”
en: This is why the best and the worst

zh: 可以同时发生的原因。
en: can happen at the same time.

zh: 社会更方便了，
en: Society can become more convenient,

zh: 不等于咱们出售的能力更稀缺了。
en: without the skills we sell becoming scarcer.

zh: 那我们今天能做什么？
en: So what can we do today?

zh: 从现在到未来几年，我觉得就做这三件事。
en: From now through the next few years, focus on three things.

zh: 第一，保留你现在的真实领域。
en: First, retain a real field of practice.

zh: 不要只做“会用AI的人”。
en: Do not become merely a person who can use AI.

zh: 你要知道一个行业、一个客户、
en: Understand an industry, a customer,

zh: 一类场景里面，真实的问题到底长什么样。
en: and what real problems look like in a specific setting.

zh: 第二，就是留下可复用的资产。
en: Second, preserve reusable assets.

zh: 每次用AI解决问题，
en: Whenever you solve a problem with AI,

zh: 把流程、模板、案例、反馈，
en: keep the process, templates, cases, and feedback,

zh: 还有失败记录，一定要留下来。
en: as well as the record of failure.

zh: AI让一次执行更便宜，
en: AI makes one execution cheaper,

zh: 你要让一次经验能被下一次调用。
en: so make that experience reusable next time.

zh: 第三，用真实的任务持续去校准。
en: Third, keep calibrating with real tasks.

zh: 固定拿你手里现在干的事去试：
en: Repeatedly test the work already in your hands:

zh: 哪里省时间，哪里出错，哪里还需要人，
en: where time is saved, where errors occur, and where people remain necessary,

zh: 哪里必须由你来拍板。
en: and where you must make the final decision.

zh: 所以我们现在就回到开头：
en: Now return to the opening:

zh: 三十年河东，三十年河西。
en: fortune shifts from one side to the other.

zh: 这一次，位置变化不需要三十年。
en: This time, positions will change in less than thirty years.

zh: 但决定你位置的，
en: What determines your position

zh: 也不是今天你装了哪个AI、用了哪些工具、
en: is not which AI you installed or which tools you used,

zh: 背了哪个提示词。
en: nor which prompt you memorized.

zh: 未来十年真正值得积累的是：
en: What is truly worth building over the next decade is this:

zh: 你能不能看懂真实问题，
en: can you understand real problems,

zh: 组织机器和工具，留下资产，
en: organize machines and tools, preserve assets,

zh: 并对结果负责。
en: and take responsibility for results?

zh: AI会放大人的意图。
en: AI amplifies human intent.

zh: 问题是，你的意图到底指向哪里？
en: The question is: where does your intent point?

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
